jobs.description:
Department of Biomedical Sciences – Trypanosoma Unit 
 

For a more detailed research context, please refer to the PDF document.
 

Your role:
 

 · Develop an innovative and internationally competitive research programme on trypanosomes, with a strong foundation in fundamental parasite biology and/or host–parasite–vector interactions.
 

· Develop, apply and disseminate state-of-the-art experimental approaches in fundamental research, which may include advanced molecular biology, biochemistry, imaging, cell biology, multi-omics and/or computational methods, according to the candidate’s expertise and research interest.
 

· Be willing to take responsibility for and further develop the unit’s existing translational and applied research portfolio, including its contribution to HAT diagnosis, molecular surveillance and control programmes, as well as the scientific use and maintenance of its tsetse fly facility.
 

· Establish and foster strong global partnerships and collaborations.
 

· Acquire competitive research funding and build up international reputation and visibility.
 

· Contribute actively to the development and delivery of the educational portfolio of the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM, including supervision of Master students and PhD training.
 

· Build and lead a team of scientific and technical staff, take up management responsibilities appropriate to the academic level.
 

· Collaborate with other units in the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM to develop complementary research lines on vector-borne and protozoan diseases.
 

· Contribute expertise to national and international bodies and stakeholders, where relevant to the candidate’s field.
 

· Oversee and direct ITM’s WHO Collaborating Centre for Research and Training on Human African Trypanosomiasis Diagnostics.
 

· Promote and contribute to the strategic vision of the department and to relevant ITM committees.

Profile / Requirements
 

· A PhD degree in biology, veterinary sciences, biomedical sciences, biochemistry, medicine, or equivalent field. 
 

· An excellent research profile in experimental/molecular parasitology of Trypanosomatids. 
 

· Experience with advanced experimental and/or computational approaches relevant to the proposed research programme. 
 

· A proven track record of successful grant writing and project supervision, in accordance with the candidate’s career stage. 
 

· A collaborative scientific profile and ability to develop interdisciplinary and international collaborations. 
 

· Experience in translational or applied research, capacity strengthening, and collaboration with institutions in endemic countries is considered an asset. 
 

· Prior experience in running a tsetse fly facility is not essential, though an interest in helping to run and utilize the tsetse facilities is considered an asset. 
 

· Experience in academic teaching and training in the field of parasitology is highly valued. 
 

· Excellent communication skills and respectful people management skills. 
 

· Fluent in English. Knowledge of French is an asset. Active knowledge of Dutch is desirable. If you do not have these skills, willingness to acquire a working level of Dutch is requested. 
 

· You support the mission and values of the ITM.

To support our further growth ambitions, brantsandpatents is looking for
 a Patent Advisor or (partially qualified) European Patent Attorney with a background in chemistry, preferable organic chemistry.
 

As a Patent Advisor, you will analyze the R&D activities of your clients and advise them on how to protect their innovations through an appropriate IP strategy, which you will then put into practice.
 

Within the patent department, you will work with other patent advisors, -attorneys and patent paralegals. In this varied role, you will be responsible for mapping (technical) inventions, drafting patent applications, and managing and guiding the patent portfolios of clients.
 

You will keep an eye on competing innovations and advise on potential conflicts when necessary. You will also proactively propose solutions. You will represent your clients before the Belgian Intellectual Property Office and the European Patent Office.
 

You’ll work from our office in Ghent.
 

 

You have or are...
 
 

• A master’s degree (MSc) in chemistry, chemical engineering or similar, with a strong preference for organic chemistry. A PhD is a nice to have. 

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English. 

• Interest in legal principles and patent law. 

• The ambition and drive to build a career in IP and to qualify as a patent attorney.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

We are looking for a senior developer who will take ownership of designing and building high-quality, well-tested software solutions within the Transport Execution Management domain. You will work closely with the solution designer and business stakeholders to translate ideas into effective, reliable applications, gaining a deep understanding of the business context along the way.

Beyond strong technical expertise, we are looking for someone who shows initiative, communicates clearly, contributes actively to the team, and is willing to go the extra mile when needed. You are respectful and calm in your interactions. Independence is key in this role: taking full responsibility for delivering complete solutions is part of your daily work. At the same time, you value teamwork and knowledge sharing. In line with the Pros values of SNCB, you bring professionalism and a constructive attitude that helps the team move forward.

• .NET development: Over 10 years of experience

• Azure Cloud development: Over 5 years of experience

• .NET Core Web API development: Over 5 years of experience

• .NET for Android (Xamarin): Over 5 years of experience

• Blazor: At least 2 year of experience

• Professional expertise in unit testing

• Fluent in English (C2)

• On-site presence: Up to 20 business days on site at the Ypto office in Brussels during the assignment. The required on-site presence will be determined by Ypto based on business needs.

Evaluation criteria

The extent to which the proposal demonstrates the required competencies and complies with the stated requirements will be taken into account during the evaluation. Proposals that demonstrate these competencies and requirements more clearly, comprehensively, and convincingly will receive a higher score. Where specific experience is requested, a greater amount of demonstrable relevant experience will result in a higher evaluation score.

• .NET development - demonstrates deep mastery of the .NET ecosystem: language features, LINQ, async/await, security practices, and selecting appropriate data structures and patterns.

• Android - Working experience developing complex native .NET for Android / Xamarin applications. deep mastery of the Android lifecycle, native binding.

• Code quality & craftsmanship - writes clean, maintainable, and SOLID code that follows best practices.

• Web API design & development - designs secure, performant .NET Core Web APIs.

• Azure cloud - leverages Azure services, PaaS components, and event-driven patterns effectively.

• Unit testing & test quality - creates meaningful, maintainable, and automated unit tests.

• CI/CD & DevOps practices - sets up robust Azure DevOps pipelines and manages containerized deployments with Kubernetes & Docker.

• SQL & database design - models, queries, and optimizes relational databases.

• GIT & Version Control - applies branching strategies and collaborates efficiently using GIT.

• Collaboration & communication - proven ability to explain technical choices clearly, work constructively in a team, and retain a professional posture in stressful situations or environments.

jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate and monitor extrusion machines and production lines.

• Set up machines and adjust process parameters according to production requirements.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.

Job Description

As a Dispatch and Labelling Line Supervisor  you will have a varied and responsible role.

Under the guidance of the Dispatch Team Leader, you will ensure that labelling and packaging activities are carried out correctly, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

You will coordinate and guide the employees working on the production line, ensuring that every product meets the applicable quality and food safety requirements, as well as customer specifications.

You will gradually grow into your role. You will start by being responsible for one production line. As you gain experience, the aim is for you to be able to operate and supervise all lines.

The Line Supervisor has an operational, monitoring, and coordinating role on the shop floor. You will ensure that the daily production schedule is completed within the allocated time while maintaining the required quality standards.

 

A selection of your responsibilities:

• Allocate tasks, provide clear work instructions, and guide employees working in filling and labelling. You will also help train new colleagues.

• Set up, operate, and change over packaging and labelling machines. Troubleshoot minor technical issues independently and report defects to the technical department in a timely manner.

• Check labels: use the ERP system to assign the correct production order to the right line and ensure that every product receives the correct label.

• Perform and record quality checks, including metal detection, residual oxygen measurements, visual packaging inspections, seal integrity checks, and final product weight checks.

• Ensure that each customer's packaging, labelling, and palletising instructions are followed correctly. Check stacking patterns, quantities, and pallet labels.

• Monitor compliance with HACCP, IFS Food, Food Defense, and hygiene requirements, and report any deviations to the Quality Department or your supervisor.

 

Who are you?

 

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English, including speaking, understanding, and reading. French is an advantage!

• You have experience working as an operator in another company, preferably in the food industry.

• You are familiar with packaging and labelling machines, including operating, setting up, and changing them over.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are stress-resistant and comfortable working at a fast pace on machinery. Things can get quite busy at Kjure-Marblo!

• You have strong administrative skills and are confident using computers.

• As working in the food industry involves strict quality, hygiene, and safety requirements, gel nails, excessive make-up, eyelash extensions, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted. We prefer a natural look. :-)

• You are comfortable working in a cold environment, with temperatures around 4°C.

What does a reachtruckchauffeur do here? You keep goods flowing smoothly. As a reachtruckchauffeur, you move products, load and unload trucks, and prepare orders for shipping.

It’s a bit like being a traffic controller—but inside a warehouse. You’ll also check quality and keep things tidy and safe.

Are you the right reachtruckchauffeur? You have experience, a valid certificate, and feel confident on a reach truck.

As a reachtruckchauffeur, you’re flexible with shifts and communicate in English or Dutch.

You work accurately, safely, and like being part of a team.

jobs.occupation: Senior Test Manager - AI-Assisted Testing - Brussels
jobs.description:
Location: Brussels, BelgiumDuration: 12 months, renewableWorking arrangement: Hybrid - 2 days/week on-site after onboarding. 
About the company
Our client is a leading Belgian company operating in the financial services sector, offering a wide range of solutions and services.As part of its ongoing digital transformation, the company is looking for a Senior Test Manager to lead and coordinate testing activities within its Application team. 
About the role
You will coordinate testing activities and guide a team of Test Analysts, ensuring quality, efficiency and successful project delivery.Your main responsibilities will include: 

• Coordinating testing activities across different projects
• Defining and overseeing test strategies, plans and execution.
• Working closely with Business Analysts, IT teams and other stakeholders.
• Managing priorities, resources, deadlines and testing risks.
• Following up on test execution, defects and delivery progress.
• Remaining hands-on and supporting the team beyond reporting and coordination.
• Promoting the use of AI to improve test planning, test case generation and overall testing efficiency.
• Guiding team members in the effective use of AI and sharing your expertise across the team.
The ideal candidate
• Proven experience as a Senior Test Manager or in a similar role.
• Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools and best practices.
• Mandatory: Proven hands-on experience using AI in real testing activities and projects.
• Good command of English and at least one Belgian national language (French or Dutch); trilingualism is a strong advantage.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong delivery mindset and ability to manage challenging deadlines.
• Hands-on approach, with the ability to get involved in operational testing activities.
• Ability to translate AI knowledge into practical testing approaches and coach team members.

Experience in test automation is a plus, but practical AI experience is the priority.
